prompt: What is the name of the town or city of birth of the player who won the men's singles at the US Open on the year after Venus & Serena Williams played each other for the 8th time as pros?
answer:
Venus and Serena Williams played each other for the eighth time at the **2001 US Open**. The following year’s men’s singles champion, **Pete Sampras**, won the **2002 US Open**.

Pete Sampras was born in **Washington, D.C.**
